sponsored.t: Makes major revisions to provisions of the alcoholic beverage control law relating to the issuance of licenses and hours of operation
sponsored.sum: Relates to the effectiveness of provisions of law relating to the powers of the chairman and members of the state liquor authority (Part A); authorizes special permits to remain open during certain hours of the morning (Part B); relates to permissible sales by license holders (Part C); allows multiple off-premises licenses (Part D); relates to licensing restrictions for manufacturers and wholesalers of alcoholic beverages and retail licensees (Part E); relates to the approval of seven day licenses to sell liquor at retail for consumption off the premises (Part F); relates to changes of ownership of a licensed business (Part G); relates to the issuance of temporary retail permits; makes…

sponsored.t: Sets standards for advertising affordable housing
sponsored.sum: Sets standards for advertising deeply affordable housing.

sponsored.t: Extends certain provisions of law relating to requiring regulations to permit tuition waivers for certain firefighters and fire officers for CUNY until July 1, 2028
sponsored.sum: Extends certain provisions of law relating to requiring regulations to permit tuition waivers for certain firefighters and fire officers for CUNY until July 1, 2028.

sponsored.t: Relates to establishing minimum standards for payment plans for eligible customers
sponsored.sum: Relates to establishing minimum standards for payment plans for eligible customers; requires the public service commission to set standards for payment plans for certain customers including reasonableness of agreements and timelines for payment; establishes eligibility.

sponsored.t: Prohibits hospitals and health care providers from storing credit card information without consent
sponsored.sum: Prohibits hospitals and health care providers from storing credit card information without signed written consent and requires disclosure if such information could be used to pay balances.

sponsored.t: Relates to residential solar and energy storage permitting
sponsored.sum: Requires all authorities having jurisdiction over a population exceeding five thousand residents to adopt a residential automated solar permitting platform by June thirtieth, two thousand twenty-seven.

sponsored.t: Relates to owner liability for failure of an operator to comply with street cleaning parking rules
sponsored.sum: Relates to owner liability for failure of an operator to comply with street cleaning parking rules; relates to access to records prepared pursuant to street cleaning parking rules.

sponsored.t: Establishes a private right of action for deed theft
sponsored.ls: Real Property Actions and Proceedings Law
sponsored.sum: Establishes a private right of action for deed theft; provides that victims of deed theft may maintain an action against a deed thief or a bank that provides a loan that assists in the commission of deed theft; authorizes victims of deed theft to recover actual damages, treble damages and attorneys' fees; defines terms.

sponsored.t: Relates to electronic signatures on the form MV-82, application for registration/title
sponsored.sum: Requires the commissioner of motor vehicles to accept electronic signatures on form MV-82, application for registration/title.

sponsored.t: Requires the division of small business to conduct a study on certain stakeholder interest in a pilot program matching small businesses with content creators
sponsored.sum: Requires the division of small business to conduct a study on stakeholder interest in a pilot program matching small businesses with content creators on or before January 1, 2027.

sponsored.t: Relates to eligibility for accidental disability benefits under the heart bill
sponsored.sum: Allows a one-year window for application for a disability retirement for members of the New York state and local employees' retirement system or the New York state and local police and fire retirement system who retired from service on or after January 1, 2021 due to heart disease; provides for the repeal of such provisions upon the expiration thereof.

sponsored.t: Relates to autonomous vehicle driving
sponsored.sum: Provides that a person may operate a fully autonomous vehicle on the public roads of this state without a human driver provided that the automated driving system is engaged and the vehicle meets certain conditions; defines terms; requires insurance and that such vehicle is registered as a fully autonomous vehicle; makes related provisions.

sponsored.t: Requires community median income be used by certain affordable housing programs in N.Y. City
sponsored.sum: Requires community median income be used by certain affordable housing programs in a city having a population of one million or more; requires affordable housing programs using state funding to cover 33 percent or more of the construction costs of a building or buildings to use community median income to determine income eligibility and rent levels; exempts programs utilizing federal funding.

sponsored.t: Allows brewery supply stores to sell New York state labelled beer for off-premises consumption
sponsored.sum: Allows brewery supply stores to sell New York state labelled beer for off-premises consumption.

sponsored.t: Establishes a pilot program to provide high impact tutoring
sponsored.sum: Establishes a pilot program to provide grants to local education providers to implement high-impact tutoring programs prioritizing low-income or underserved students to address student learning loss or unfinished learning resulting from the COVID-19 pandemic.

sponsored.t: Increases the number of package store licenses able to be held by one person
sponsored.sum: Increases the number of package store licenses able to be held by one person to two; permits certain licensees to buy and sell from other certain licensees.

sponsored.t: Provides a defense from liability for certain department of sanitation vehicles standing, stopped, or parked in violation of certain bus lane restrictions in New York city
sponsored.sum: Provides a defense from liability for certain department of sanitation vehicles standing, stopped, or parked in violation of certain bus lane restrictions in New York city.

sponsored.t: Establishes the offense of vehicular homicide
sponsored.sum: Creates the crime of vehicular homicide; makes such crime a class B felony.

sponsored.t: Designates certain utility workers first responders during a declared state disaster emergency
sponsored.sum: Designates certain employees of public utilities, municipal utilities, electric corporations, gas corporations, water corporations, steam corporations, telecommunications corporations, and cable television companies as first responders during a declared state disaster emergency.

sponsored.t: Establishes a New York state prison labor board; repealer
sponsored.sum: Establishes a New York state prison labor board to ensure that all labor programs comply with the requirements of the labor law and are for the purpose of promoting successful rehabilitation, reentry and reintegration into the community and not for the purpose of earnings or cost-savings which inure to the benefit the state or any private individual or corporation; prohibits the department of corrections and community supervision from unfairly attaching, garnishing or disbursing the funds of incarcerated individuals where such individuals have not requested disbursement; requires that all interest accumulated on incarcerated individuals' funds be credited to such individual's accounts…

sponsored.t: Relates to requiring applications for retail gas station building permits to include electric vehicle charging stations
sponsored.sum: Requires applications for retail gas station building permits to include one electric vehicle charging station using direct current fast chargers at such gasoline station per four gas dispensing pumps.

sponsored.t: Establishes a central business district toll credit for commercial trucks
sponsored.sum: Establishes a tax credit for commercial trucks entering into the central business district for all additional tolls charged on trips into the central business district after the first entry per day.

sponsored.t: Relates to sales of rental vehicles
sponsored.sum: Provides that the sale of a rental vehicle to a rental business for use in such business is subject to taxes and shall not be considered a sale for resale.

sponsored.t: Relates to access to educational activities by public assistance recipients who are subject to work participation requirements
sponsored.sum: Relates to access to educational activities by public assistance recipients who are subject to work participation requirements; allows homework expected or required by an educational institution to count towards satisfaction of the work activity requirements for public assistance benefits for participants engaged in certain educational or training activities.

sponsored.t: Renames the Kingston Avenue train station to the Chabad Lubavitch World Headquarters at Kingston Avenue station
sponsored.sum: Directs the metropolitan transportation authority to rename the Kingston Avenue train station, located in the borough of Brooklyn, to the Chabad Lubavitch World Headquarters at Kingston Avenue station.

sponsored.t: Relates to the effectiveness of certain provisions relating to excluding certain food donations from sales tax
sponsored.sum: Relates to the effectiveness of certain provisions relating to excluding certain food donations from sales tax to July 1, 2026.

sponsored.t: Provides a defense from liability for certain MTA vehicles standing, stopped, or parked in violation of certain bus lane restrictions in New York city
sponsored.sum: Provides a defense from liability for MTA vehicles standing, stopped, or parked in violation of certain bus lane restrictions in New York city where such MTA vehicles were operated by an employee of the MTA performing authorized duties.

sponsored.t: Protects persons receiving care, employed, or otherwise present at a hospital from immigration arrests; prohibits federal immigration officers acting within the scope of their employment from entering hospitals
sponsored.sum: Protects persons receiving care, employed, or otherwise present at a hospital from immigration arrests; prohibits federal immigration officers acting within the scope of their employment from entering hospitals unless supported by a judicial warrant or order; defines judicial warrant or order.

sponsored.t: Establishes a small business content creator matching pilot program
sponsored.sum: Establishes a small business content creator matching pilot program; provides that the division of small business shall establish a pilot program to match small businesses that are looking for support with marketing and advertisement with content creators who can use their social media platforms to bring attention to the small businesses they are matched with.

sponsored.t: Relates to requiring the establishment of automatic payment plans
sponsored.sum: Relates to requiring the establishment of automatic payment plans; requires utility companies headquartered in New York to establish a statewide program to provide eligible participants with affordable payment plans.

sponsored.t: Establishes peer crisis diversion residences
sponsored.sum: Establishes peer crisis diversion homes; requires the commissioner to establish or contract for no less than six peer crisis diversion homes within one year.

sponsored.t: Requires broadband providers to offer high speed broadband service to certain low-income consumers
sponsored.sum: Requires broadband providers to offer high speed broadband service to certain low-income consumers at a cost of not more than five dollars per month.

sponsored.t: Enacts the New York city Caribbean steel pan educational music program act
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "New York city Caribbean steel pan educational music program act"; requires community school boards in the city of New York to authorize, where reasonable, the use of school grounds in the summer months for use by any steel pan music organization to practice for the Labor Day Parade (West Indian Carnival).

sponsored.t: Creates the Brooklyn health care commission
sponsored.sum: Relates to creating the Brooklyn health care commission which shall be charged with examining the system of general hospitals, nursing homes, ambulatory and primary care facilities, and medical school facilities in Kings county and recommending changes to that system.

sponsored.t: Establishes the youth in progress advisory board for adolescents in foster care
sponsored.sum: Establishes the youth in progress advisory board and regional teams for adolescents in foster care to provide mentorship of youths in foster care; requires reporting.

sponsored.t: Requires that a certain amount of handicapped parking spaces at certain shopping centers or facilities are equipped with electric vehicle charging stations
sponsored.sum: Requires in every shopping center or facility that has over one hundred off street parking spaces that at least one percent of the spaces, or five such spaces, whichever is less, shall be a handicapped parking space equipped with an electric vehicle charging station.

sponsored.t: Relates to African American history and achievement
sponsored.sum: Relates to establishing the commission on African American history and achievement to develop and recommend school curriculum that incorporates the contributions and achievements made by African Americans.

sponsored.t: Provides for calculating the area median income for affordable housing programs in N.Y. city
sponsored.sum: Establishes that area median income shall be calculated either per each zip code or per region in the city of New York, whichever is lower.

sponsored.t: Establishes a grant program for the installation of laundry equipment and facilities in certain schools
sponsored.sum: Establishes a grant program for public K-12 schools which are eligible for support provided under Title I of the Elementary and Secondary Education Act of 1965, for the purposes of installing laundry equipment for facilities for use by students and parents or guardians of students.

sponsored.t: Creates city university of New York center for excellence in urban education to enhance the quality of teaching in public schools in N.Y. city
sponsored.sum: Creates city university of New York center for excellence in urban education to enhance the quality of teaching in public schools in NYC; establishes the regents public school teacher loan forgiveness program to allocate awards annually to teachers who agree to teach public school in an area of New York state designated by the board of regents as having a shortage of public school teachers.

sponsored.t: Requires the commissioner of motor vehicles to create a bicycle with electric assist battery swapping pilot program in N.Y. city
sponsored.sum: Requires the commissioner of motor vehicles to create a bicycle with electric assist battery swapping pilot program in a city with a population of one million or more.

sponsored.t: Establishes the first of April as the annual reporting deadline for the basic educational data system (BEDS)
sponsored.sum: Establishes the first of April as the annual reporting deadline for the basic educational data system (BEDS); imposes some additional requirements for calculating and reporting a school's student population.

sponsored.t: Relates to notices to voters of registration cancellation or inactive status
sponsored.sum: Ensures that boards of elections provide adequate notice to each voter before and after a board cancels the voter's registration or places such voter in inactive status.

sponsored.t: Relates to increasing access to resources for culturally diverse arts and culture organizations that advocate for diversity, equity and inclusion, racial and social justice, and cultural preservation
sponsored.sum: Increases access to resources for culturally diverse arts and culture organizations that advocate for diversity, equity and inclusion, racial and social justice, and cultural preservation.

sponsored.t: Mandates the use of advanced safety technology in vehicles in the state and requires the commissioner of motor vehicles to promulgate certain rules and regulations
sponsored.sum: Mandates the use of advanced safety technology in vehicles in the state; requires the commissioner of motor vehicles to promulgate certain rules and regulations.

sponsored.t: Establishes an affordable housing program
sponsored.sum: Establishes an affordable housing program to be administered by the division of homes and community renewal which will provide loans or grants to certain property owners; provides that property owners receiving such loans or grants shall rent such property for no more than thirty-three percent of a tenant's income.

sponsored.t: Grants priority to charter school applicants with a board of trustees and school administrators that are at least fifty-one percent minority group members
sponsored.sum: Grants priority to charter school applicants with a board of trustees and school administrators that are at least fifty-one percent minority group members.

sponsored.t: Expands access to mortgage loans for cooperative properties under the homes for veterans program
sponsored.sum: Expands access to mortgage loans for cooperative properties under the homes for veterans program, as administered by the state of New York mortgage agency.

sponsored.t: Requires municipal corporations to adopt senior citizen rent increase exemption programs and disability rent increase exemption programs
sponsored.sum: Requires all municipal corporations to adopt senior citizen rent increase exemption programs and disability rent increase exemption programs within one year.

sponsored.t: Establishes an independent inspector general in each county for police oversight purposes
sponsored.sum: Establishes an independent inspector general in each county to oversee police activity and investigate allegations of police misconduct.

sponsored.t: Relates to establishing the New York state education equity fund and authorizing the dormitory authority of the state of New York to invest to cover capital costs for charter schools
sponsored.sum: Establishes a New York state education equity fund; authorizes the dormitory authority of the state of New York (DASNY) to invest $75 million in a public-private partnership revolving loan fund for loan financing to cover capital costs for the construction and improvements of public charter schools.

sponsored.t: Sets the amount of the allowance that trial and grand jurors are entitled to at the minimum wage
sponsored.sum: Sets the amount of the allowance that trial and grand jurors are entitled to at the applicable minimum wage based on the court's location.

sponsored.t: Enacts the faith-based affordable housing act
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "faith-based affordable housing act" for development on residential land; defines terms; provides that each village, town, and city shall allow the construction and occupation of residential buildings on any covered site up to the specified densities; provides that all residential buildings constructed pursuant to this section in a town, village, or city with fewer than one million inhabitants shall set aside twenty percent of the residential floor area for households earning an average of eighty percent of area median income; outlines the densities for New York city; makes related provisions.

sponsored.t: Relates to prohibiting the release of consumption data
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the release of a consumer's electrical or gas consumption data to any police officer, or private, local, state or federal law enforcement entity without a judicial court-ordered subpoena, warrant or the consumer's written consent.

sponsored.t: Relates to flexible working arrangements for parents and legal guardians when day care centers and schools are closed during a state or local disaster emergency
sponsored.sum: Allows parents and legal guardians to work from home; allows flexible working arrangements during a public health emergency or state or local disaster emergency which closes schools or day care centers; defines terms; creates a rebuttable presumption that an employee can work remotely if such employee has done so for two consecutive pay periods or two weeks; creates a civil penalty for violations.

sponsored.t: Directs a pilot program for the use of digital license plates
sponsored.sum: Directs a pilot program for the use of digital license plates on motor vehicles.

sponsored.t: Relates to enacting the "Community Violence Intervention and Prevention Act"
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "Community Violence Intervention and Prevention Act"; provides findings for evidence-based and evidence-informed health programs from hospital-based and community-based programs.

sponsored.t: Relates to including accountable care organizations within the definition of a managed care provider
sponsored.sum: Includes accountable care organizations within the definition of a managed care provider.

sponsored.t: Limits the Triborough bridge and tunnel authority with regard to the number of tolls charged on trucks
sponsored.sum: Limits tolls charged on trucks.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "electric super highway act"
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "electric super highway act", requiring alternative fuels to be available for public use along the New York state thruway after November 1, 2025 and providing each recommended alternative fuel at least every one hundred twenty miles on both sides of the thruway; defines "alternative fuel".

sponsored.t: Establishes a youth outreach department within the state police, city, village, town, and district police departments, and sheriff departments
sponsored.sum: Establishes a youth outreach department within the state police, city, village, town, and district police departments, and sheriff departments for the purposes of designing and carrying out youth activities organized by the department.

sponsored.t: Requires social media networks to verify the age of account holders
sponsored.sum: Requires social media networks to use a third party vendor to verify the age of new and existing social media account holders.

sponsored.t: Establishes a user-friendly benefits cliff calculator tool
sponsored.sum: Establishes a user-friendly benefits cliff calculator tool that allows users to understand how changes to gross income can affect eligibility for public assistance programs and long-term financial self-sufficiency and sustainability.

sponsored.t: Provides doula services at all correctional institutions and local correctional facilities
sponsored.sum: Provides doula services at all correctional institutions and local correctional facilities; requires the department of corrections and community supervision to retain an organization to make at least two doulas at any given time available to provide doula services twice a week, for four hours, at all correctional institutions and local correctional facilities that house incarcerated individuals who identify as female, as well as to provide doula services during labor and delivery, upon request.

sponsored.t: Imposes an additional real estate transfer tax on the sale or transfer of single-family residential property by certain large investors
sponsored.sum: Imposes an additional real estate transfer tax on the sale or transfer of single-family residential property by certain large investors in an amount equal to the sale price of the single-family residential property.

sponsored.t: Relates to expanding employee ownership assistance for lesbian, gay, bisexual, transgender and non-binary individuals
sponsored.sum: Relates to expanding employee ownership assistance for lesbian, gay, bisexual, transgender and non-binary individuals.

sponsored.t: Provides for a waiver of certain liquor license renewal fees
sponsored.sum: Provides for a waiver of certain liquor license renewal fees during the calendar year 2025.

sponsored.t: Relates to determining whether the state can claim federal financial participation for coverage of and payment for certain evidence-based mobile medical applications
sponsored.sum: Directs the department of health to request guidance from the Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services to determine whether the state can claim federal financial participation for coverage of and payment for certain evidence-based mobile medical applications.

sponsored.t: Relates to establishing requirements and penalties for combination utility companies during service outages
sponsored.sum: Relates to establishing requirements and penalties for combination utility companies during service outages; provides that a penalty for failure to reasonably comply with requirements that protect the overall reliability and continuity of combination utility company services shall be up to one hundred dollars per violation or for a pattern or practice of such violations up to one thousand dollars per violation.

sponsored.t: Establishes a long COVID-19 review board for the purpose of reviewing the research and data in the state on long COVID
sponsored.sum: Establishes a long COVID-19 review board for the purpose of reviewing the research and data in the state on long COVID and developing and disseminating findings, recommendations, and best practices to contribute to the prevention of long COVID.

sponsored.t: Relates to requiring every residential lease to provide conspicuous notice of the availability of community solar for the provision of a tenant's electricity needs
sponsored.sum: Relates to requiring every residential lease to provide conspicuous notice of the availability of community solar for the provision of a tenant's electricity needs.

sponsored.t: Establishes the COVID heroes grant program
sponsored.sum: Establishes the COVID heroes grant program to award a lump sum pay differential of $2,500 to essential SUNY hospital employees who worked during the COVID-19 state disaster emergency.

sponsored.t: Relates to establishing the New York state loan redemption program for certain public school teachers
sponsored.sum: Relates to establishing the New York state loan redemption program for certain public school teachers.

sponsored.t: Requires liability insurance for bicycles, bicycles with electric assist and electric scooters in N.Y. City
sponsored.sum: Requires liability insurance for bicycles, bicycles with electric assist and electric scooters in cities having a population of one million or more.

sponsored.t: Requires license plates for bicycles, bicycles with electric assist and electric scooters
sponsored.sum: Requires license plates for bicycles, bicycles with electric assist and electric scooters in New York city; requires a one time registration; requires a registration fee for such license plates.

sponsored.t: Requires persons possessing any firearm to hold a firearms safety certificate
sponsored.sum: Requires persons possessing any firearm to hold a firearms safety certificate; establishes application and training process therefor; makes technical corrections.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "Excelsior Opportunity Accounts Act"
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "Excelsior Opportunity Accounts Act"; establishes a special fund for EO accounts within the department of financial services for certain eligible individuals born after December 31, 2027, who reside in the state, are under age 18, with household income not exceeding 700% of the poverty level; provides for contribution and investment of monies of fund.

sponsored.t: Permits the retention of electronic dealer records
sponsored.sum: Permits the retention of electronic dealer records provided that such records can be accessed and provided to a requestor during reasonable business hours.

sponsored.t: Establishes the first-time homebuyer assistance program within the state of New York mortgage agency
sponsored.sum: Establishes the first-time homebuyer assistance program within the state of New York mortgage agency to provide assistance to first-time homebuyers of certain residential units.

sponsored.t: Provides for the suspension of a commercial driver's license if a driver has been convicted of a violation of local laws relating to a designated system of truck routes
sponsored.sum: Provides for the suspension of a commercial driver's license if a driver has been convicted of a violation of local laws relating to a designated system of truck routes.

sponsored.t: Requires new businesses to take a sales tax education course and lowers the statute of limitations for sales tax liability to ten years
sponsored.sum: Requires new businesses to take a sales tax education course; lowers the statute of limitations for sales tax liability from 20 years to ten years.

sponsored.t: Relates to the use of canines trained to detect drugs and firearms during inspections of day care facilities
sponsored.sum: Requires the use of canines trained to detect drugs and firearms during inspections of day care facilities or premises.

sponsored.t: Establishes the first-generation homebuyer assistance program
sponsored.sum: Establishes the first-generation homebuyer assistance program to provide a zero-interest, forgivable loan award in the amount of up to $15,000 to first-generation homebuyers.

sponsored.t: Relates to the issuance, records, and delivery of certificates of title; requires the establishment of an electronic lien and title program
sponsored.sum: Relates to the issuance, records, and delivery of certificates of title; requires the establishment of an electronic lien and title program.

sponsored.t: Establishes an emergency insulin program
sponsored.sum: Establishes an emergency insulin program and corresponding emergency insulin program trust fund to facilitate emergency access to analog insulins.

sponsored.t: Establishes the "save our small-business grant program" to aid certain small businesses impacted by the COVID-19 pandemic
sponsored.sum: Establishes the "save our small-business grant program" to aid certain small businesses impacted by the COVID-19 pandemic.

sponsored.t: Relates to enacting the "N.Y. state digital equity plan act"
sponsored.ls: New York State Urban Development Corporation Act
sponsored.sum: Relates to enacting the "N.Y. state digital equity plan act"; requires the division of broadband access to develop a state digital equity plan to increase broadband access to underserved populations by January 1, 2027.

sponsored.t: Relates to requiring the establishment of utility customer arrears reporting
sponsored.sum: Relates to requiring the establishment of utility customer arrears reporting; requires utilities to report to the public service commission on customers who are in arrears.

sponsored.t: Relates to establishing discount programs for veterans
sponsored.sum: Relates to establishing discount programs for veterans; provides that utilities, waterworks corporations, telephone corporations and cable television companies shall create discount programs that provide a 10 percent discount to veterans; defines terms.

sponsored.t: Disregards the federal child tax credit in calculating an individual taxpayer's federal adjusted gross income
sponsored.sum: Disregards any amount included in an individual taxpayer's federal adjusted gross income as a result of the federal child tax credit for purposes of calculating an individual taxpayer's federal income tax deduction.

sponsored.t: Imposes a surcharge on monthly phone bills to fund the costs of a 9-8-8 suicide prevention and behavioral health crisis hotline
sponsored.sum: Imposes a surcharge on monthly phone bills to fund the costs associated with the administration, design, installation, construction, operation, and maintenance of a 9-8-8 suicide prevention and behavioral health crisis hotline in New York state; establishes the 9-8-8 suicide prevention and behavioral health crisis hotline trust fund.

sponsored.t: Relates to assaults on seniors on public transportation
sponsored.sum: Provides that an assault on a senior citizen on public transportation shall be a class D violent felony punishable by up to 7 years in prison.

sponsored.t: Grants provisional MWBE certification status for applicants who are not approved or denied for MWBE status within ninety days of applying
sponsored.sum: Grants provisional MWBE certification status for one year for applicants who do not receive a determination approving or denying their application for MWBE certification within ninety days of applying.

sponsored.t: Relates to a free or reduced meal plan for certain students enrolled at state and city universities
sponsored.sum: Directs the boards of trustees of SUNY and CUNY to create a free or reduced meal plan to aid students whose household incomes are below the federal poverty line, students participating in educational opportunity programs under section three hundred fifty-five-d of this article and students receiving federal Pell grants.

sponsored.t: Relates to including used vehicles in the drive clean rebate program
sponsored.sum: Relates to including used vehicles in the drive clean rebate program; provides that such rebate for a used vehicle shall not exceed one thousand dollars.

sponsored.t: Directs the New York state energy research and development authority to conduct a study of the technical and economic feasibility and ratepayer impact of a zero emission electrical system
sponsored.sum: Directs the New York state energy research and development authority to conduct a study of the technical and economic feasibility and ratepayer impact of a zero-emission electrical system and a reduction in greenhouse gas emissions.

sponsored.t: Relates to providing net revenues from utility-owned large-scale renewable generation projects to low-income customers and authorizes utility companies to own such projects
sponsored.sum: Relates to providing net revenues from utility-owned large-scale renewable generation projects to low-income customers; authorizes utility companies to own such projects; provides that the commission shall require labor agreements and labor peace agreements.

sponsored.t: Requires utility companies to reimburse consumers in the event of a prolonged power outage
sponsored.sum: Requires utility companies to reimburse consumers for spoilage of food and medication due to the lack of refrigeration in the event of a power outage lasting seventy-two hours or more.

sponsored.t: Increases the tax exemption amount on clothing and apparel items from one hundred ten dollars to two hundred dollars
sponsored.sum: Increases the tax exemption amount on clothing and apparel items from one hundred ten dollars to two hundred dollars.

sponsored.t: Relates to increasing fines for individuals who fail to comply with a stop work order
sponsored.sum: Relates to increasing fines for individuals who fail to comply with a stop work order; increases fines from $6,000 to $10,000 for initial violation and $12,000 to $20,000 for subsequent violations.

sponsored.t: Establishes a sea level rise mitigation and adaptation plan for New York city
sponsored.sum: Establishes a sea level rise mitigation and adaptation plan for cities with a population of one million or more to be implemented by the department of environmental conservation; requires a sea level rise vulnerability and adaptation report to be submitted.

sponsored.t: Adjusts the compensation of formerly incarcerated individuals who were unjustly convicted
sponsored.sum: Retroactively adjusts the compensation of formerly incarcerated individuals who were unjustly convicted; exempts such adjusted income from state income taxes.

sponsored.t: Provides for the return of fines, restitution and reparation payments where there was an unjust conviction
sponsored.sum: Provides for the return of fines, restitution and reparation payments and any interest thereon where a defendant is subsequently pardoned upon the ground of innocence or the conviction is reversed or vacated.

sponsored.t: Establishes scramble crosswalks leading to and from school buildings during times of student arrival and dismissal
sponsored.sum: Establishes scramble crosswalks leading to and from school buildings during times of student arrival and dismissal to ensure all vehicular traffic is stopped while pedestrians are crossing in the same intersection.

sponsored.t: Authorizes not-for-profit corporation inclusion as minority and women-owned enterprises
sponsored.sum: Authorizes not-for-profit corporation inclusion as minority and women-owned enterprises.

sponsored.t: Relates to providing secondary school pupils and adults in career education programs access to programs/courses sufficient to comprise a career major in electric vehicle maintenance and repair
sponsored.sum: Relates to providing secondary school pupils and adults in career education programs access to programs/courses sufficient to comprise a career major in electric vehicle maintenance and repair; establishes the working group on electric vehicle career education achievement.

sponsored.t: Relates to a fee waiver for applications to SUNY and CUNY
sponsored.sum: Authorizes a fee waiver for applications to SUNY and CUNY if a prospective student, either a high school senior, or a person completing a gap year, submits and completes the FAFSA form.

sponsored.t: Directs the commissioner of motor vehicles to establish a mandatory bicycle with electric assist and electric scooter training course and an optional bicycle training course
sponsored.sum: Directs the commissioner of motor vehicles to establish a mandatory bicycle with electric assist and electric scooter training course; directs the commissioner of motor vehicles to establish an optional bicycle training course.

sponsored.t: Increases the income eligibility threshold for the tuition assistance program
sponsored.sum: Increases the income eligibility threshold for the tuition assistance program up to one hundred fifty thousand dollars.

sponsored.t: Requires the department of agriculture and markets to develop and maintain a database on the impact of climate change on agriculture
sponsored.sum: Requires the department of agriculture and markets to develop and maintain a database on the impact of climate change on agriculture; requires farmers to report to the department on the impact of climate change on agriculture, including but not limited to crops grown, outcomes and yield.

sponsored.t: Authorizes child care assistance to be made available to certain victims of domestic violence
sponsored.sum: Authorizes child care assistance to be made available to certain victims of domestic violence who are in need of assistance in order for a parent or caretaker relative to engage in work or participate in work activities.

sponsored.t: Requires windows in newly constructed multiple dwellings with two or more stories to be fitted with key-operated window locks
sponsored.sum: Requires windows in newly constructed multiple dwellings with two or more stories to be fitted with key-operated window locks that restrict the window from opening more than four inches.

sponsored.t: Relates to including statistics on childbirth complications, fetal loss, and other injuries in information for maternity patients
sponsored.sum: Includes statistics on childbirth complications, fetal losses, other injuries and other maternity outcomes in information for maternity patients.

sponsored.t: Relates to members of a mobile crisis team
sponsored.sum: Provides that members of a mobile crisis team shall include any combination of behavioral health professionals, certified peer specialists, certified recovery peer advocates, credentialed family peer advocates, and credentialed youth peer advocates.

sponsored.t: Relates to the hours adult-use cannabis shall be sold for on-site consumption
sponsored.sum: Relates to the hours adult-use cannabis shall be sold for on-site consumption; provides cannabis products shall only be sold for on-site consumption between the hours of 11 a.m. and 11 p.m.

sponsored.t: Designates a portion of the state highway system as the "Dr. John Flateau Memorial Highway"
sponsored.sum: Designates a portion of the state highway system in the county of Kings, the "Dr. John Flateau Memorial Highway".

sponsored.t: Directs the New York state higher education services corporation to conduct an audit of the excelsior scholarship program to determine the financial need and diversity of scholarship applicants and recipients
sponsored.sum: Directs the New York state higher education services corporation to conduct an audit of the excelsior scholarship program to determine the financial need and diversity of scholarship applicants and recipients; provides for the repeal of such provisions upon the expiration thereof.

sponsored.t: Authorizes and directs the commissioner of agriculture and markets to conduct a study on climate resilient crops and climate smart farming practices
sponsored.sum: Authorizes and directs the commissioner of agriculture and markets to conduct a study on climate resilient crops and climate smart farming practices; requires the commissioner to report to the governor and legislature within one year with recommendations for legislation and administrative programs.

sponsored.t: Relates to the use of external consumer data and information sources being used when determining insurance rates
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the use of external consumer data and information sources being used when determining insurance rates; provides that no insurer shall unfairly discriminate based on race, color, national or ethnic origin, religion, sex, sexual orientation, disability, gender identity, or gender expression; or use any external consumer data and information sources, as well as any algorithms or predictive models that use external consumer data and information sources, in a way that unfairly discriminates based on race, color, national or ethnic origin, religion, sex, sexual orientation, disability, gender identity, or gender expression; makes related provisions; defines terms.

sponsored.t: Relates to establishing an immigrant workers' bill of rights
sponsored.sum: Directs the commissioner of labor to establish an immigrant worker's bill of rights.

sponsored.t: Makes certain liquor license fees payable in installments
sponsored.sum: Makes certain liquor license fees payable in installments; reduces the fee for certain types of licenses.

sponsored.t: Establishes an additional low emission zone toll in the central business district
sponsored.sum: Establishes an additional low emission zone toll in the central business district for vehicles that do not meet federal emission standards as set by the United States environmental protection agency.

sponsored.t: Relates to rental discrimination based upon consumer credit history
sponsored.sum: Relates to rental discrimination based upon consumer credit history; prohibits a person from refusing to rent or lease or otherwise to deny to or withhold from any person or group of persons housing accommodations because of the consumer credit history of such person or persons, or to represent that any housing accommodation is not available for rental or lease when in fact it is so available; defines consumer credit history.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "Lead-Free Homes Act"
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "Lead Free Homes Act"; requires the department of health to promulgate standards for lead remediation and abatement of exemption; provides tax credits to class A multiple dwelling owners who undertake a successful lead remediation or abatement; requires lead testing on drinking water prior to the sale of residential property; requires owners of class A multiple dwellings to perform lead testing and provides for fines for violations.

sponsored.t: Relates to health facilities and services in correctional facilities
sponsored.sum: Relates to health facilities and services in correctional facilities.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the department of motor vehicles to establish a program encouraging persons to scrap such person's petroleum or diesel motor vehicle in favor of a zero emission or electric motor vehicle
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the department of motor vehicles to establish a program encouraging persons to scrap such person's petroleum or diesel motor vehicle in favor of a zero emission or electric motor vehicle by providing a five hundred dollar rebate for the purchase of such new zero emission or electric motor vehicle.

sponsored.t: Relates to allowing for municipal enforcement of the New York state uniform fire prevention and building code and to the disbursement of intervenor funds under the major renewable energy development program
sponsored.sum: Relates to allowing for municipal enforcement of the New York state uniform fire prevention and building code and to the disbursement of intervenor funds under the major renewable energy development program; adds compliance filings as a basis for receiving intervenor funds; provides reimbursement for pre-application activities.

sponsored.t: Requires medallion owners to manage payments of the congestion surcharge
sponsored.sum: Requires medallion agents to manage payments of the congestion surcharge.

sponsored.t: Requires school districts to establish a language assistance program for limited English proficient parents of students
sponsored.sum: Requires school districts to establish a language assistance program for limited English proficient parents of students; requires record keeping and annual reporting; permits districts to jointly establish such programs.

sponsored.t: Relates to establishing a program of health care quality innovation and improvement through home care
sponsored.sum: Establishes a program of health care quality innovation and improvement through home care.

sponsored.t: Increases the amount of income property owners may earn for the purpose of eligibility for the property tax exemption for persons over sixty-five years of age
sponsored.sum: Increases the amount of income property owners may earn for the purpose of eligibility for the property tax exemption for persons over sixty-five years of age; increases such amount to $75,000.

sponsored.t: Designates Pinkster day as a day of commemoration
sponsored.sum: Designates Pinkster day as a day of commemoration annually on the seventh Sunday after Easter.

sponsored.t: Requires the mandatory reporting of suspected child abuse or maltreatment by certain employees of the metropolitan transportation authority
sponsored.sum: Requires the mandatory reporting of suspected child abuse or maltreatment by certain employees of the metropolitan transportation authority; requires such employees to complete coursework or training regarding the identification and reporting of child abuse and maltreatment.

sponsored.t: Establishes the SUNY downstate medical support fund
sponsored.sum: Establishes the SUNY downstate medical support fund to provide financial support for infrastructural upgrades and expansion; facilitates research and development grants in medical and health-related fields; offers scholarships and financial aid; supports community health initiatives and outreach programs.

sponsored.t: Requires the department of labor to study the long-term impact of artificial intelligence on the state workforce
sponsored.sum: Requires the department of labor to study the long-term impact of artificial intelligence on the state workforce including but not limited to job performance, productivity, training, education requirements, privacy and security; prohibits any state entity from using artificial intelligence in any way that would result in the displacement of any currently employed worker or loss of position, including partial displacement such as a reduction in the hours of non-overtime work, wages or employment benefits, or results in the impairment of existing collective bargaining agreements.

sponsored.t: Relates to providing residents of municipal public housing in the state with free basic cable and high-speed internet service
sponsored.sum: Relates to providing residents of municipal public housing in the state with free basic cable and high-speed internet service, and reimbursing internet service providers and cable television companies for providing such service.

sponsored.t: Relates to written notification to schools of a student's placement in foster care
sponsored.sum: Relates to written notification to schools of a student's placement in foster care.

sponsored.t: Requires the commissioner of health to develop a sustainability plan for the state university of New York downstate medical center
sponsored.sum: Requires the commissioner of health to develop a sustainability plan for the state university of New York downstate medical center; provides that such sustainability plan shall not limit or alter the rights of employees pursuant to a collective bargaining agreement.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "build to need act"
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "build to need act" to meet the state's electrification and climate related policy mandates; directs the public service commission to implement a grid planning process; makes related provisions.

sponsored.t: Relates to increasing fines for parking violations
sponsored.sum: Relates to increasing fines for parking violations from fifty to one hundred dollars.

sponsored.t: Requires certain persons and officials, teachers, superintendents and certain professionals to complete training in reporting cases of suspected child abuse
sponsored.sum: Requires certain persons and officials required to report suspected child abuse and maltreatment to complete ongoing training; requires all teachers, school superintendents and licensed professionals who are required to report cases of child abuse and maltreatment to complete training in the reporting of suspected cases of child abuse and maltreatment at least once every 2 years.

sponsored.t: Establishes a wireless electric vehicle charging program
sponsored.sum: Directs NYSERDA to establish a wireless electric vehicle charging program to research and provide incentives to eligible entities for projects to construct, install, or improve existing wireless charging infrastructure and technology for electric vehicles, including performance, safety, electromagnetic compatibility, interoperability, development, and testing of wireless charging.

sponsored.t: Establishes the commission for the modernization and revitalization of the state university of New York downstate medical center
sponsored.sum: Establishes the commission for the modernization and revitalization of the state university of New York downstate medical center which directs such commission to conduct a study to examine services that should be offered at SUNY downstate medical center; directs the commission to submit a report and make recommendations to the legislature.

sponsored.t: Permits a real property tax freeze to be granted to certain persons sixty-five years of age or older
sponsored.sum: Permits persons sixty-five years of age or older to be granted a real property tax freeze in a city with a population of one million or more.

sponsored.t: Relates to requiring the department of transportation to prepare a plan for every public transportation system to be eligible to receive assistance in the purchase of new zero-emission buses or vehicles
sponsored.sum: Relates to requiring the department of transportation to prepare a plan for every public transportation system to be eligible to receive operating assistance in the purchase of new zero-emission buses or vehicles.

sponsored.t: Prohibits bank investments in bad faith landlords
sponsored.sum: Prohibits a state chartered banking institution from providing financing to a landlord who has engaged in certain bad faith acts.

sponsored.t: Relates to providing a re-entry employment incentive tax credit
sponsored.sum: Relates to providing a re-entry employment incentive tax credit for taxpayers who hire individuals convicted of a felony in the last five years and who have been released from a correctional facility or are serving a period of post-release supervision in the last five years.

sponsored.t: Requires the department of corrections and community supervision to offer civic engagement courses to incarcerated individuals prior to their release
sponsored.sum: Requires the department of corrections and community supervision to provide a nonpartisan, peer-led civic engagement program for incarcerated individuals in all correctional facilities in this state which shall be completed by each incarcerated individual within one year prior to their release.

sponsored.t: Relates to assault in the second degree
sponsored.sum: Makes the crime of preventing an elected official from performing a lawful duty or essential service a class D felony of assault in the second degree.

sponsored.t: Establishes New York state renewable electric generation pilot programs
sponsored.sum: Establishes New York state renewable electric generation pilot programs to authorize the development of up to three hundred megawatts of renewable electric capacity statewide, in order to stimulate the growth of clean, affordable and reliable sources of energy and to foster new partnerships between electric corporations, energy producers and energy customers in this state.

sponsored.t: Relates to the theft of benefits contained on an electronic benefit transfer card
sponsored.sum: Provides that the theft of benefits contained on an electronic benefit transfer card shall be a class D felony punishable by a fine of ten thousand dollars.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the banning of books or other materials by libraries or library systems
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the banning of books or other materials by libraries or library systems; provides that no library or library system shall receive state aid unless such entity adopts the American Library Association's Library Bill of Rights that indicates materials should not be proscribed or removed because of partisan or doctrinal disapproval or develops a written statement prohibiting the practice of banning books or other materials.

sponsored.t: Implements "Cassie's law"
sponsored.sum: Implements "Cassie's law" which provides a private right of action for crime victims against persons or private entities who suppress evidence of a crime in exchange for monetary compensation.

sponsored.t: Relates to damaged, defective or duplicated ballots
sponsored.sum: Requires that any ballot that is torn, bent, or otherwise damaged or defective shall be identified and set aside for duplication; provides that an election official or a set of witnesses shall examine such ballot to determine the voter's intention and mark up a new ballot marked "duplicate", bearing the same serial number as the damaged or defective ballot; makes related provisions.

sponsored.t: Requires notification to voters of each candidate to be voted on in each election prior to each such election
sponsored.sum: Requires each county board of elections to notify voters in such county of each candidate to be voted on in each election prior to each such election.

sponsored.t: Establishes the advanced coursework expansion incentive grant program
sponsored.sum: Establishes the advanced coursework expansion incentive grant program to school districts who offer advanced courses to economically disadvantaged students.

sponsored.t: Enacts the voting integrity and verification act of New York (VIVA NY)
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "voting integrity and verification act of New York (VIVA NY)"; provides that each voter is entitled to the use of an individual, voter verifiable paper ballot of the voter's vote and the opportunity to mark it.

sponsored.t: Relates to the contents, and adjudication, of notices of violation returnable to a parking violations bureau and increase certain fines
sponsored.sum: Relates to the contents and adjudication, of notices of violation returnable to a parking violations bureau in New York city; increases the fine for tractors, trailers, or related vehicles that park on residential streets overnight.

sponsored.t: Establishes a New York city grant program for laundry equipment or facilities in certain schools
sponsored.sum: Establishes a grant program for New York city's public K-12 schools which are eligible for support provided under Title I of the Elementary and Secondary Education Act of 1965, for the purposes of installing laundry equipment for facilities for use by students and parents or guardians of students.

sponsored.t: Requires third-party accommodation reservation services identify themselves as such to users and not charge certain fees
sponsored.sum: Requires third-party accommodation reservation services identify themselves as such to users and not levy certain cancellation fees.

sponsored.t: Relates to moments of silent meditation in public schools
sponsored.sum: Requires teachers to offer students the option to participate in a one-minute period of silent meditation at the beginning of each school day.

sponsored.t: Provides for review of bail data reports by the state commission on judicial conduct
sponsored.sum: Provides for review of bail data reports by the state commission on judicial conduct to study such reports for evidence of bias or prejudice by any judge or justice, and where appropriate based on such reports, to initiate, investigate, and hear complaints and otherwise comment on matters of bias and prejudice evidenced therein.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "New York urban and community tree planting and forestry program act"
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "New York urban and community tree planting and forestry program act"; provides for education, technical assistance and support for tree planting and forestry projects in urban areas and disadvantaged communities.

sponsored.t: Enacts the New York small business growth and support act
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "New York small business growth and support act"; authorizes certain tax exemptions for newly established small businesses during their first three years of operations.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "public education racial equity and diversity act"
sponsored.sum: Relates to promoting equity and diversity in educational leadership and prioritize the issuance of new charters to community-based organizations run by individuals from historically underrepresented communities.

sponsored.t: Establishes the "New York municipal asset forfeiture accountability act"
sponsored.sum: Establishes the "New York municipal asset forfeiture accountability act" which requires that all funds lawfully seized by a county sheriff or other municipal police agency shall go to such municipalities' general fund.

sponsored.t: Establishes a fixed fee for the purchase of registration lists and title information
sponsored.sum: Provides that the commissioner of motor vehicles shall affix a cost for the sale of registration lists and title information or other records in bulk at the annual cost not to exceed $1,520,000; authorizes such commissioner to impose other requirements; makes related provisions.

sponsored.t: Establishes the affordable housing broadband assistance grant program
sponsored.ls: New York State Urban Development Corporation Act
sponsored.sum: Establishes the affordable housing broadband assistance grant program within the division of broadband access to support no-cost and/or discounted subscriptions for households receiving federal, state, or local housing assistance or residing in housing units designated for low-income and/or vulnerable populations.

sponsored.t: Expands eligibility for participation in the pre-licensing course internet pilot program
sponsored.sum: Expands eligibility for participation in the pre-licensing course internet pilot program; extends such provisions of law from June 30, 2025 to June 30, 2030.

sponsored.t: Relates to off premise retail license holders
sponsored.sum: Relates to off premise retail license holders; increases the number of licenses authorized under section 63 of the alcoholic beverage control law from one to two licenses.

sponsored.t: Requires all state entities to notify affected individuals in the event of a data breach where information is compromised
sponsored.sum: Requires all state entities, including local governments, to notify affected individuals in the event of a data breach where information is compromised; defines "cybersecurity incident".

sponsored.t: Exempts site safety manager services, site safety coordinator services and concrete safety manager services from the sales and compensating use tax
sponsored.sum: Exempts site safety manager services, site safety coordinator services and concrete safety manager services from the sales and compensating use tax.

sponsored.t: Removes the requirement for candidates to include their home address on petition forms
sponsored.sum: Removes the requirement that candidates include their home address on nominating or designating petition forms.

sponsored.t: Establishes open enrollment schools
sponsored.sum: Establishes open enrollment schools; provides that nonresidents of a district, if otherwise eligible to enroll into a public school of this state are entitled to enroll into the school or schools of another district or city if the nonresident district's board of education has adopted an open enrollment policy and enrolling the nonresident pupil is consistent with such policy.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "facial identification and transparency in immigration enforcement act"
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "facial identification and transparency in immigration enforcement act"; requires federal immigration enforcement agents to identify themselves as such when conducting enforcement activities.

sponsored.t: Renames the Winthrop street subway station in the borough of Brooklyn to the SUNY Downstate at Winthrop Avenue station; and provides for the repeal of such provisions upon expiration thereof
sponsored.sum: Renames the Winthrop street subway station on the IRT Nostrand Avenue Line of the NYC subway, located in the borough of Brooklyn, to the SUNY Downstate at Winthrop Avenue station.

sponsored.t: Authorizes a tax credit for qualified diaper changing station restroom expenses
sponsored.sum: Authorizes a tax credit for seventy percent of the qualified diaper changing station restroom expenses paid or incurred by a taxpayer.

sponsored.t: Limits damages that can be recovered in a tort claim by uninsured motorists, intoxicated drivers, and those convicted of a felony during which the accident occurred
sponsored.sum: Limits damages that can be recovered by plaintiffs who were uninsured motorists, intoxicated drivers, or convicted of a felony during which the accident occurred in tort claims.

sponsored.t: Requires artificial intelligence technology used in professional fields to be developed and maintained in consultation with experts in such fields
sponsored.sum: Requires experts in professional fields to be consulted when developing and maintaining artificial intelligence technology for use in such fields.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "shutdown impact mitigation act"
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "shutdown impact mitigation act" relating to providing emergency financial assistance and consumer protections to federal employees and contractors residing in New York state who experience loss of income due to a federal shutdown.

sponsored.t: Relates to access to educational activities by public assistance recipients who are subject to work participation requirements
sponsored.sum: Relates to access to educational activities by public assistance recipients who are subject to work participation requirements; allows homework expected or required by an educational institution to count towards satisfaction of the work activity requirements for public assistance benefits for participants engaged in certain educational or training activities.

veto.text: VETO MESSAGE - No. 127 TO THE ASSEMBLY: I am returning herewith, without my approval, the following bill: Assembly Bill Number 4502-B, entitled: "AN ACT to amend the social services law, in relation to access to educational activities by public assistance recipients who are subject to work participation requirements" NOT APPROVED This bill would adjust which educational and work activities can count toward federally mandated work participation requirements for public assistance recipients. I support enabling public assistance recipients to pursue qualifying educational activities and vocational training to help meet their work participation requirements. However, adjusting the educational and work activities that can satisfy work participation requirements may impact eligibility for public assistance. sponsored.t: Directs the commissioner of mental health to conduct a study of child- and youth-targeted mobile crisis outreach teams in New York state
sponsored.sum: Directs the commissioner of mental health to conduct a study of child- and youth-targeted mobile crisis outreach teams in New York state, and deliver a report including the findings and recommendations of such study to the governor, the temporary president of the senate, and the speaker of the assembly.

veto.text: VETO MESSAGE - No. 64 TO THE ASSEMBLY: I am returning herewith, without my approval, the following bills: Assembly Bill Number 33, entitled: "AN ACT in relation to establishing the task force to promote the employment of people with disabilities" Assembly Bill Number 468, entitled: "AN ACT directing the commissioner of motor vehicles to conduct a study of official inspection stations, safety inspections and fees" Assembly Bill Number 1988-B, entitled: "AN ACT to amend the public health law, in relation to establishing a center for technical assistance relating to age-friendly health systems; and in relation to hospital performance data" Assembly Bill Number 2468, entitled: "AN ACT to amend the public service law, in relation to creating the state office of the utility consumer advocate" Assembly Bill Number 2497, entitled: "AN ACT establishing a fiscal cliff task force to conduct a…

sponsored.t: Excludes certain food donations from sales tax
sponsored.sum: Excludes food sold to a student purchasing a meal using an approved donation program of funds or food points from sales tax.

sponsored.t: Relates to bus lane restrictions in New York city
sponsored.sum: Provides that it shall be a defense to any prosecution for a violation of a bus lane restriction pursuant to a bus rapid transit program when an employee of the metropolitan transportation authority is performing authorized duties on behalf of such authority and is operating an authorized employer motor vehicle in the bus lane at the time of the violation and conducting lawful business or providing service to an official metropolitan transportation authority vehicle or personnel while in a bus lane.

sponsored.t: Relates to authorizing early parole release for incarcerated individuals where substance abuse was a significant contributing factor in the commission of the offense
sponsored.sum: Relates to authorizing early parole release for incarcerated individuals where substance abuse was a significant contributing factor in the commission of the offense.

sponsored.t: Relates to veteran maternity care; and relates to the effectiveness of a chapter relating thereto
sponsored.sum: Relates to veteran maternity care; relates to the effectiveness of a chapter relating thereto.
